primary.substrate: local launchd agent on Buyan's Mac
primary.label: mn.gerege.nbfi.softhouse-program
primary.why: Vector capture and conformance need the Fineract reference oracle + PostgreSQL on localhost. Only this fire can advance them.

catchup.role: Catch-up when the Mac was off: source analysis, DEC/spec drafts, Tier-C gap audit, Tier-D corpus mining. Parks vector/conformance work as oracle_unreachable.

scheduler.mutual_exclusion: .softhouse/LOCK — repo-level lock, pushed so both fires see it. A fire finding a lock under 6h old exits without dispatching. Stale locks (>6h) are taken over.

stop_conditions: the only remaining work is a pending user gate
the oracle is unreachable AND no analysis/spec work remains that does not need it

contexts.title: Conformance harness, DEC-1 frozen contract, progressive-loan schedule-generator PoC
contexts.notes: Planned. Everything else depends on the harness existing.

contexts.title: General Ledger / accounting — double-entry posting, chart of accounts, journal entries, accruals, product-account mapping
contexts.notes: 12,752 LOC in fineract-accounting + 11,224 in provider/accounting [VERIFIED: measured]. Split by run if a single plan exceeds worker context: journal posting | accruals | COA + product mapping.

contexts.title: Loan products, interest methods, schedule generation (full progressive-loan module)
contexts.notes: 14,308 + 6,153 LOC. 7,863 test LOC in fineract-progressive-loan is the richest vector seam in the codebase.

contexts.title: Loan account lifecycle — disbursement, repayment, penalties, rescheduling, write-off, delinquency
contexts.main_loc_note: 66,375 + 39,871 [VERIFIED: measured]. LARGEST context — must be split across several runs by sub-behavior (disbursement | repayment allocation | penalties/charges application | rescheduling | write-off/delinquency). A single plan over all of it will exhaust every worker.

contexts.title: Charges, rates, tax — including VAT / e-Barimt tie-in
contexts.notes: 3,694 + 1,926 + 2,262 + 947 + 1,089 + 415 [VERIFIED: measured]. Mongolian VAT / e-Barimt is additive, not a Fineract port — spec it, do not invent parity vectors for it.

contexts.title: Close-of-business batch — daily accrual/aging/posting, idempotency, restart-after-failure
contexts.notes: 3,190 + 4,881 + 5,400 [VERIFIED: measured]. Reuse Nexus's scheduler; do not port Fineract's job framework.

contexts.title: Provisioning + FRC reporting feeds (Tier-A completion)
contexts.notes: Tier-A cutover + regulatory acceptance are user gates; parallel run required. Compliance-spine capital and 30%/70% limits must reconcile to the native GL.

contexts.title: Savings / deposits / recurring deposits / interest rate charts — ported DISABLED
contexts.activation_gate: user — deposit-taking activation requires FRC / Bank of Mongolia licensing sign-off. Ships behind a config flag defaulting to OFF. Never render deposits as insured/protected/guaranteed.
contexts.notes: 25,331 + 31,890 + 3,729 + 960 [VERIFIED: measured]. Split by run: savings account lifecycle | interest posting | recurring/fixed deposits | rate charts.

contexts.title: Working-capital loan module
contexts.notes: 355 files, 6,138 test LOC [VERIFIED: measured]. Split by sub-behavior.

contexts.title: Share accounts + share products (SCC member shares)
contexts.notes: 6,203 + 3,209 [VERIFIED: measured]. Member share capital feeds the compliance-spine capital figure — reconcile against the native GL.

contexts.title: Collateral + collateral management + post-dated cheques
contexts.notes: Pledged-collateral hold math: holds alter available only, never posted balance. This is the exact defect that failed adversarial review twice on the sister project — force the sign when re-deriving.

contexts.title: Clients, groups, centres, meetings, calendar, collection sheet, addresses, notes, transfers, funds
contexts.notes: Names are ovog / patronymic / given name — a diff introducing first_name/last_name is a rejection. National ID validated structurally, 10 chars. Match on registration number, never on name. Split by run; clients and groups are separate slices.

contexts.title: Platform layer — MAP onto Nexus, port only demonstrated gaps
contexts.notes: First run in this context is an ANALYST GAP AUDIT, not a port: for each subsystem (auth, tenancy, command bus, jobs, hooks, events, bulk import, campaigns, data queries, credit bureau, SMS/GCM, surveys, reporting mail) state what Nexus already provides and what is a real gap. Only audited gaps get coder tasks. ~72k core + ~81k provider/infrastructure + ~10k organisation [VERIFIED: measured]. Unjustified plumbing ports are rejections.

contexts.title: Mine Fineract's test corpus + e2e suites into golden vectors
contexts.notes: ~321k test LOC. Runs OPPORTUNISTICALLY — whenever a Tier A/B context is planned, its slice of this corpus is mined in the same run's test_writer task. Kept as a distinct context so residual suites are not forgotten. Never ported one-for-one into Go tests.

database.rule: PostgreSQL is the ONLY database for every environment: the Fineract reference oracle, the Go module, vector capture, shadow/differential runs and CI. Fineract's shipped default is already Postgres [VERIFIED: fineract-provider/src/main/resources/application.properties -> org.postgresql.Driver, jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/fineract_tenants]. Bring the oracle up with the postgresql compose profile only.
database.money_columns: bigint minor units — never float/double precision/real/money
database.terminology: 'The oracle' in this program means the Fineract REFERENCE IMPLEMENTATION (.softhouse/reference-oracle.md), never Oracle Database.
